info.title: Valora Money API
info.description:
**Where Money Becomes an Asset.** Simulated multi-currency trading platform.

> SIMULATION MODE — all balances and transactions are virtual. No real money is transferred.

Authenticate with `POST /api/auth/login` (sets an httpOnly cookie used by this page).

post.description: Create an account and start a session. The next step is wallet creation.
Log in with email **or** username. Sets an httpOnly session cookie.
Revoke the current session server-side and clear the cookie.

patch.description: Edit permitted profile fields. Email and username are fixed identifiers.

post.description: Change password and sign out every other session.
Open the user's single active Valora Wallet and credit the configured virtual starting balance.

get.description: Every non-zero currency holding in the wallet, valued in the wallet's base currency.

schema.title: Response Get Holdings Api Wallet Holdings Get

post.description: Add **virtual** demo credit (no real money). Limited per request and per day; recorded in the ledger.

schema.title: Response List Fundings Api Wallet Fundings Get

get.description: The wallet's immutable debit/credit audit trail.
Recent trades, virtual funding and expired/cancelled quotes, newest first.

schema.title: Response Activity Api Wallet Activity Get
Response Currencies Api Market Currencies Get
Response Pairs Api Market Pairs Get

get.description: Latest stored rate per pair with the change versus 24 hours earlier.

schema.title: Response Rates Api Market Rates Get

get.description: Find the pair that trades FROM → TO, regardless of which side is the pair's base.
Bucketed OHLC history from stored snapshots. `simulated` marks buckets containing demo data.
Is market data Live, Delayed or Stale? Rates refresh every 1–2 minutes, never tick-by-tick.

post.description: Lock a rate for QUOTE_VALIDITY_SECONDS. All amounts are computed server-side.

Settle a quote atomically. Repeating the request (same quote or same Idempotency-Key) never
executes twice — it returns the original trade with `replayed: true`.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an already-settled quote

get.description: The caller's executed trades, newest first, with filters.
Full trade detail with its ledger entries and realized P&L.
Holdings with average cost, market value, realized and unrealized P&L (weighted-average cost).
Portfolio value over time, rebuilt from the ledger and stored rate history.
